$comment: Pair 2 of the twins contract, the path rule (ADR 0024 steps 9, 43, 44 and 62; build notes N9 to N12, N16, N22 and the owner's O1 answer, O1-d, O1-g, O1-h, O1-i; contract 3.1 to 3.5). SQL: v_path_step_status, v_path_progress and v_path_enrollment_terms for (path, learner), in assert-0107-parity.sql (P2). TypeScript: pathProgress() on the same rows, in tests/unit/context-parity.test.ts; terms is the view's answer, an input there. Each step's rule is resolved as the view resolves it: the step's own pass_required, else the course's. A writer case also calls record_learning_activity on call.writer_attempt_id (the record's D14 check, step 63; O1-c). Rows use database column names; ids are symbols; synthetic rows only.

cases.name: path/D14: pass, grant, failed retake: passed_ever and done, latest failed, not failed (the writer agrees)
path/fail, grant, pass: passed_ever, latest passed
path/failed under pass_required with no grant: failed, not done, the next step is that step
path/failed with a live granted retake: not failed, retake_live, the path in progress
path/N9: an open legacy path retake whose grant reads individual: retake_live, not failed
path/completed and failed on a step that requires no pass: done
path/learner B: the step completed only in the Individual context is not done in path:P1
path/N12: a passed abandoned row and a passed practice row are not passed_ever
path/a legacy_role preview tagged with the path is ignored
path/a step's own pass_required (false) overrides the course's (true)
path/a completed path with a step added later stays completed with steps_done below steps_total (section L)
path/every step done with no completion row: not completed, in progress (N22)
path/learner O: an Everyone path with a self-enrolment row: enrolled, no due date though an org-wide row has one, never overdue
path/the writer on a passed step 1 of 2: official, done, the fact written, the path not completed (O1-c)
path/a path-context row on a course that is no longer a step changes neither status, started_at nor steps_total
path/one step failed and another passed, not completed: failed
path/N11: one step failed and a live granted retake on another: in progress
path/a learner with abandoned path rows only reads not started (0099)
path/N11: a completed path with a live granted retake reads in progress, completed, not overdue past its due date
path/N11: the same path after the retake failed reads completed again; the step stays done (D14)
path/a path past its due date and not completed is overdue
path/O1-g (1): a fact row, the step now pass-required, the standing result completed and not passed: done stays done
path/O1-g (2): the same with the rule tightened at the course: the fact keeps the step done
path/O1-g (4): no fact and the rule relaxed: done at once by the rule

path/no fact, the step pass-required, the standing result completed and not passed: not done, not failed (a state of rows; the procedural O1-h (2), relaxed then tightened, is now recorded by the rule-change trigger, O3)
path/O1-g (11): a fact row, the step now pass-required, then a completed granted retake that failed: done, not failed, latest failed
path/O1-g (11), while the retake is live: retake_live, the path in progress, the step still done
